2. दधि n. (replaced in the weakest forms by ˚धन् [Pāṇ. vii, 1, 75] : instr. &c. ˚ध्ना, ˚ध्ने, ˚ध्नस्; loc. ˚धनि, ĀśvGṛ. i, 24, 5 and ŚvetUp. i, 5, or ˚ध्नि, [ifc.] Suśr. vi, 40, 150) coagulated milk, thick sour milk (regarded as a remedy; differing from curds in not having the whey separated from it), RV. &c.

a: दधि — n. [दध्-इन्] 1 Coagulated milk, thick sour milk; क्षीरं दधिभावेन परिणमते S. B; दध्योदनः &c. --2 Turpentine. --3 A garment. --Comp. --अन्नं, --ओदनं boiled rice mixed with दधि. --उत्तरं, --उत्तरकं(गं) the skim of curdled milk, whey. --उदः, --उदकः the ocean of coagulated milk. --कूर्चिका mixture of boiled and coagulated milk. --चारः a churningstick. --जं fresh butter. --फलः the wood-apple (कपित्थ). --मंडः, --वारि n. whey. --मंथनं churning coagulated milk. --शोणः a monkey. --सक्तु m. pl. barley-meal mixed with coagulated milk. --सारः, --स्नेहः fresh butter. --स्वेदः buttermilk.

s: strI, (daDinirmmitA DenuH .) dAnArTadaDyAdinirmmitA DenuH । yaTA, varAhapurARe । “daDiDenormmahArAja ! viDAnaM SfRu sAmpratam । anulipte mahIBAge gomayena narADipa ! ॥ gocarmmamAtre tu punaH puzpaprakaraSoBite । kuSErAstIryya vasuDAM kfzRAjinakuSottarAm ॥ daDikumBaM susaMsTApya sadA DAnyacayopari । caturTAMSena vatsantu sOvarRamuKamaRqitam ॥ AcCAdya vastrayugmena puzpaganDEstu pUjitAm । brAhmaRAya kulInAya sADuvfttAya DImate ॥ kzamAdiguRayuktAya dadyAttAM daDiDenukAm । pucCadeSopavizwastu mudrikAkarRamAtrakEH ॥ pAdukopAnahO CatraM dattvA mantramanusmaret । daDikrAvnetimantreRa daDiDenuM pradApayet ॥ evaM daDimayAM DenuM dattvA rAjarzisattama ! । ekAhAro dinaM tizWeddaGnA ca nfpanandana ! ॥ yajamAno vasedrAjan trirAtraYca dbijottama ! । dIyamAnAM prapaSyanti te yAnti paramAM gatim ॥ yatra kzIravahA nadyo yatra pAyasakarddamAH । munaya fzayaH sidDAstatra gacCanti DenudAH ॥ ya idaM SrAlayedBaktyA SfRuyAdvApi mAnavaH । so'SvameDaPalaM prApya vizRulokaM sa gacCati ॥”
v: strI dAnArTaM kalpitadaDikumBanirmite DenuBede tadviDAnaM hemA॰ dA॰ skandapu॰ ukto yaTA “daDiDenomahArAja! viDAnaM SfRu sAmpratam । anulipte mahIBAge gomayena narADipa! । gocarmmamAtrantu punaH puzpaprakarasaMyutam । kuSErAstIryya vasuDAM kfzRAjinakftAstarAm । daDikumBaYca saMsTApya saptaDAnyasya copari । caturTAMSena vatsantu sOvarRamuKasaMyutam । praSastapatraSravaRAM muktAPalamayakzaRAm । candanAguruSfNgIM ca muKaM vE ganDamAlikam । jihvA SarkarayA rAjan! GrARaM SrIKaRqakaM taTA । PalamUlamayA dantAH sitasUtrasya kambalAH । tAmrapfzWA darBaromA pucCaM sUtramayaM taTA । svarRaSfNgIM rOpyaKurIM navanItamayastanIm । ikzupAdAM susaskftya sarvABaraRaBUzitAm । AcCAdya vastrayugmena puzpaganDEstu pUjitAm । brAhmaRAya kulInAya sADuvfttAya DImate । samADiyamayuktAya tAdfSAya pradApayet । pucCadeSopavizwAya mudrikAkarRamAtrakEH । pAdukopAnahO CatraM dattvA mantramanusmaret । daDikrAvRetimantreRa daDiDenu pradApayet । evaM daDimayIM DenuM dattvA rAjarzisattama! । ekAhAro dinaM tizWeddaDA ca nfpanandana! । yajamAno vasedrAjan! tridivaM ca dvijottamaH! dIyamAnAM prapaSyanti te'pi yAnti parAM gatim । daSa pUrvAn daSa parAnAtmAnaYcEkaviMSakam । vizRulokamavApnoti yAvadAhUtasaMplavam । dAtA ca dApakAScEva te'pi yAnti parAM gatim । yatra maDuvahA nadyo yatra pAyasakarddamAH । fzayo munayaM sidDAstatra gacCanti DenudAH । ya idaM SfRuyAdBaktyA SrAvayedvApi mAnavaH । so'SvameDaPalaM prApya vizRulokaM sa gacCati” । vftaDenuviDivat sarvamatra karmma ।
